decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - It is considered that this application for the erection of a single storey rear extension, to the existing dwellinghouse would not be detrimental to the appearance of the original dwellinghouse or the character of the street scene, to the amenities of the neighbouring properties or the Spring Grove Conservation Area.  On balance, the development is in accordance with Policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development), B.2.2 (Conservation Areas) and H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) of The London Borough of Hounslow UDP, Adopted December 2003; and is generally compliant with Council's Residential Extension Guidelines.  It is considered that where the development is not compliant there are no undue adverse effects resulting from this.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority (before the building(s) is/are occupied/used).

Condition : 5 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the western wall of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
description: Erection of single storey extension to dwellinghouse.
